fomod.Description: Status icons for the player and up to three NPCs on iWant Status Bars: arousal, wear and tear, cum, milk, pregnancy, parasites, needs, survival, hygiene, hair, baby health, stress, injuries and diseases, plus a stack of meters. The installer asks which icon style you want: the ring set drawn for 3.0.0, or the classic icons, which now cover every set.
